title: Biallelic LGI1 and ADAM23 variants cause hippocampal epileptic encephalopathy via the LGI1-ADAM22/23 pathway.

reviewer.method: Complete main text and entire32-page supplementary text read in untruncated chunks. All three main figures, all seven mainTable1columns, all seven supplemental tables and four supplemental figures inspected in pixels. Supplementpp22-32 pixels complete; pp1-21 text only. All five mapped patient assertions adjudicated individually. No per-case benchmark outcomes.

audit.exposure_note: Required HANDOFF contains aggregate compact-cohort metrics. No per-case inference ranks, scores or outcomes opened or used. Post-inference source audit, not blinded validation.
